title: Driving While Suspended or Revoked
grade_or_penalty: Motor vehicle violation: 1st offense $500 fine; 2nd offense $750 and 10 days jail; 3rd offense $1,000 and 10 days jail, plus additional suspension. Enhanced penalties if suspended for DWI or refusal (2C:40-26 can make it a crime)
key_points: Driving while one's license or registration privilege is suspended or revoked.
Check the reason for suspension: DWI or refusal suspensions trigger mandatory jail and possible criminal charges.
elements: The suspect drove a motor vehicle on a public road
The suspect's driving privilege (or registration) was suspended or revoked
Record the reason for the suspension (DWI or refusal suspensions trigger enhanced penalties)
